title: It's time to reinvent the table element
body:
Because table related elements have long history, they have lots of quirks when rendered. For example, [Chrome has suffered a pesky glitch that prevents the `<th>` element to be used with `position: sticky`](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=712847&q=th%20sticky&can=2).

Here's what I don't like for current table implimentation:
1. You can't write vertical tables unless you set `writing-mode: vertical-lr` or `writing-mode: vertical-rl` in the CSS;
2. You can't clearly see which cell is related to which header columns.
3. Coalescing table cells with `rowspan` and `colspan` can easily make the structure of tables difficult to understand.
4. `<colgroup>` element is terribly outdated. It virtually exists only for declaring the style, which is now the territory for CSS.
5. I simply don't like the abuse of abbreviation in the most early HTML elements. This makes the learning curve sharper. Now most editors have auto completion, full name like `<tableheader>` (instead of `<thead>`) should be used instead.
6. Why the `<caption>` element doesnt have `t` prefix, while the element is only for tables?

So I'd like to invent new grammar.

```
<table direction="row">
	<caption>Description</caption>
	<tablehead> <!-- replaces <thead>. -->
		<tablerow> <!-- replaces <tr>. -->
			<tableprime id="data1">Heading 1</tableprime > <!-- replaces <th>. Doesn't use the word "header" in order to avoid confusion between <tablehead>. -->
			<tableprime id="data2">Heading 2</tableprime >  <!-- id is necessary to effectively connects the cells.  -->
			<tableprime id="data3">Heading 3</tableprime >
			<tableprime id="data4">Heading 4</tableprime >
			<tableprime id="data5">Heading 5</tableprime >
		</tablerow>
	</tablehead>
	<tablebody> // replaces <tbody>
		<tablerow>
			<tabledata for="data1">内容1</tabledata>  <!-- "for" attribute works like the "columns" attribute, but has new purpose. -->
			<tabledata for="data2 data3">内容2</tabledata>  <!-- This connects the 2nd column and the 3rd column.  This makes connection between cells cleaner and ditches "colspan" attribute. -->
			<tabledata for="data4">内容3</tabledata>
			<tabledata for="data5">内容4</tabledata>
		</tablerow>
		<tablerow>
			<!-- If there's no data corresponding, the cell is rendered empty. -->
			<tabledata for="data2 data4">内容6</tabledata>  <!-- This connects the 2nd column and the 4th column.  -->
			<tabledata for="data3">異常</tabledata>   <!-- This viorates the connection above. Should not be rendered.  -->
			<tabledata for="data5">内容7</tabledata>
		</tablerow>
		<tablerow>
			<sub-table>  <!-- This devides the table row vertically. This makes "rowspan" attribute obsolete.  -->
				<tablerow>  <!-- The first devided row.  -->
					<tabledata for="data1">内容8</tabledata>  <!-- "for" refers to the master table.  -->
					<tabledata for="data2">内容9</tabledata>
					<tabledata for="data3">内容10</tabledata>
					<tabledata for="data4">内容11</tabledata>
				</tablerow>
				<table-data>  <!-- The second devided row.  -->
					<tabledata for="data1">内容12</tabledata>
					<tabledata for="data2">内容13</tabledata>
					<tabledata for="data3">内容14</tabledata>
					<tabledata for="data4">内容15</tabledata>
				</table-data>
			<tabledata for="data5">内容16</tabledata> <!-- This cell is rendered as 2 rows long.  -->
			</sub-table>
		<tablerow>
		<tablerow>
			<tabledata for="data1">内容17</tabledata>
			<tabledata for="data3">内容19</tabledata> <!-- This cell is placed at the 3rd column.  -->
			<tabledata for="data2">内容18</tabledata> <!-- This cell is placed at the 2nd column.  -->
			<tabledata for="data4">内容20</tabledata>
			<tabledata for="data5">内容21</tabledata>
			<tabledata for="data5">内容22</tabledata> <!-- The 5th column is devided into two, so <tableprime> and the other <tabledata> for data5 <tableprime> doesn't need colspan.  -->
		</tablerow>
		<tablerow>
			<tabledata>内容23</tabledata> <!-- This cell is placed at the 1st column.  -->
			<tabledata>内容24</tabledata>
			<tabledata>内容25</tabledata>
			<tabledata for="data5">内容26</tabledata> <!-- This cell is placed at the 5th column.  -->
			<tabledata>内容27</tabledata>  <!-- This cell is placed at the 4th column.  -->
			<tabledata>内容27</tabledata>  <!-- This cell doesn't have associated <tableprime>, so it can't be rendered  -->
		</tablerow>
	</tablebody>
</round-table>
```
